# `=` — Equal

`=Y` self-classifies major cells. Rows correspond to distinct cells in first-occurrence order; columns correspond to Y's cells. Entries are equality masks.

```bpl
="aba"            ⍝ [$t $f $t ⋄ $f $t $f]
```

`X=Y` tests equality, pervasively. NaN equals nothing, as IEEE 754 defines.

```bpl
1 2 3=2            ⍝ $f $t $f
0.3=0.1+0.2        ⍝ $t
"abc"='b'          ⍝ $f $t $f
```

See [tolerance](../rules.qmd#equality-and-ordering) and whole-array [match `≡`](match.qmd).
